sections.instructions: Read the passage, then answer the questions.

questions.prompt: The two graphs show the main sources of energy in the USA in the 1980s and the 1990s. Write a report for a university lecturer describing the changes which occurred. Write at least 150 words.

When designing a building the intended use of the building should be taken into account rather than its outward appearance. To what extent do you agree or disagree? Write at least 250 words. Cambridge IELTS Tests 1 to 17
